candidate_windows.window_text:
We use all-MiniLM- $\cdot \lfloor 6 - \mathsf { v } 2$ as the screening model and bert-base-uncased as the detection base model. The screening threshold is set at $12 . 5 \%$ $( \mathbb { K } \% )$ per dataset.Batch size is 1; learning rates are $1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 5 }$ for BERT and $2 \times 1 0 ^ { - 5 }$ for other components. The user encoder is a single-layer TransformerEncoder with eight heads.We optimize with AdamW and train for 1O epochs. Training uses PyTorch 2.2 on Nvidia A100 40GB

GPUs. To mitigate randomness, we run each model three times with different seeds (Zhang et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2024).
